evidence_items.finding: owner is drawing on a personal credit line each month to meet payroll obligations despite a full maintenance contract schedule
evidence_items.rationale: Personal credit use for payroll is an acute adverse liquidity signal. Paraphrased from symptom — no must_identify vocabulary used.

evidence_items.finding: one commercial client is 120 days past the invoice date on an outstanding balance of $38,000
evidence_items.rationale: Single large overdue balance concentrated in one client is a critical liquidity risk. No must_identify terms used.

evidence_items.finding: property management and strata clients are consistently settling invoices between 60 and 90 days after issue
evidence_items.rationale: Extended settlement cycle across multiple clients creates a structural cash timing gap. No must_identify vocabulary.

evidence_items.finding: bank account balance approaches zero at end of each month despite a full contract schedule generating revenue
evidence_items.rationale: End-of-month cash depletion is a direct liquidity signal. No must_identify terms used.

evidence_items.finding: commercial landscaping business; annual revenue $920K; 9 employees; one strata client with an outstanding invoice of $38,000 unpaid beyond 120 days; average settlement period from clients is 75 days
evidence_items.rationale: Structured summary from facts_known_to_owner. Average debtor days 75 used directly. No must_identify vocabulary.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): three new maintenance contracts have recently been signed
evidence_items.rationale: New contract wins are a misleading stability signal masking the invoice collection problem.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): client relationships appear positive with no complaints from clients who are settling late
evidence_items.rationale: Positive client relationships are a misleading signal — they do not indicate timely payment behaviour.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): annual revenue has grown 18% year-on-year
evidence_items.rationale: Revenue growth masks the collection lag problem.
